description: List programs (the cross-initiative planning grouping) with status and owner. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 100 max): the result carries `meta` with `hasMore`, `nextCursor` and `appliedFilters` (the filters that actually ran). When `meta.hasMore` is true, pass `meta.nextCursor` back as `cursor` with the SAME filters to get the next page. Optionally filter by comma-separated status (PLANNING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, CANCELLED).

cursor.description: meta.nextCursor from the previous page. Only valid with identical filters.

name: anyforge_list_programs
title: List programs
